title: Juicy Indulgent British Chocolate Fish And Chips
description: A rich and indulgent British dish featuring dark chocolate chips, perfect for those looking for a unique dessert experience, this dish is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and granulated sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Dip each cod fillet into the egg mixture, then coat in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Fry the coated cod fillets in the hot oil for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the fried cod fillets on paper towels and place in a tajine clay vessel.
Melt the dark chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the fried cod fillets, then sprinkle with confectioners sugar.
Drizzle the chocolate glaze over the top of the dish, serving immediately.
Garnish with additional confectioners sugar and chocolate shavings, if desired.
